propositions: The transition lib signature uses separate force (bool), reason, and force_close params, while claim uses a unified force (str | None) param; transition CLI allows --reason to serve as force-bypass audit note, diverging from claim's --force[=<reason>] surface.

The in-memory force-bypass concept is spelled four different ways (force_reason, force_close, force_close_reason, force_plan_review) across transition and claim internals, creating naming inconsistency.
Legacy code calling transition(force_close=...) or transition(force=True) must be migrated via deprecation aliases to the new force (str | None) shape without behavior change.

The transition close-gate bypass currently keys on force_close param; it must be unified to key on force presence (force is not None) while retaining the persisted status_data[force_close_reason] key.
